name: Spirit Guardians
description: You call forth spirits to protect you. They flit around you to a distance of 15 feet for the duration. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 3d8 radiant damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
notes: Wisdom save: 3d8 radiant (half on a success). On a failure the spirits stay on it: 2d8 radiant at the start of each of its turns until it passes a Wisdom save. Concentration, 10 rounds.
